transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I really need help with something that's been happening. I know for a fact that I am being monitored and followed by a group of people everywhere I go. It's making me very anxious, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high or energized, or very depressed, around the same time this was happening? Or have these beliefs been there even when your mood felt normal?

My mood has actually been pretty normal overall. I haven't experienced any of those extreme highs or deep depressions like that. Even when I'm feeling completely steady, I still know that I'm being monitored.
Aside from feeling monitored, have you been hearing voices or noticing things others don’t, or have you had trouble organizing your thoughts or speech?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear any strange voices or see things, and my mind feels perfectly clear. My only issue is the fact that these people are constantly monitoring and tracking my every move.
How long have you been feeling certain that these people are monitoring and following you?

It has been going on for about 11 months now. It started late last year, and there hasn't been a single day since then where they haven't been watching me. It's just exhausting to have to live like this for almost a year.
Outside of the stress from this, have you been able to keep up with work, relationships, and daily responsibilities pretty much as usual?

Yes, I've been able to keep up with everything pretty well. I still go to work every day, handle my responsibilities, and see my friends and family like normal. Aside from the constant stress and anxiety of being watched, my daily life functions just fine.
Can you tell me what makes you sure these people are monitoring you, and whether it seems like something that could realistically happen in real life?

I know it's real because I see the same cars parked outside my house every morning, and I notice strangers in public places who always seem to be looking in my direction or whispering. It is absolutely happening in real life, and it's incredibly frustrating when people suggest that I might just be imagining it. I can feel their eyes on me constantly, and the patterns are just too consistent to be a coincidence.
Before this started, were you using any drugs or stimulants, drinking heavily, or did you have any new medical or neurological problems?
No, I have never used drugs or had any issues with heavy drinking. I also didn't have any medical or neurological problems before this started. My health has always been completely normal.
